india_invested.summary:
* **CYIENTDLM (CYIENTDLM)** - Stock delivered a ~10% return over nine days following its inclusion in Investing.com India's Bharat Mid-Cap Movers AI strategy.
* **EPACKPEB (EPACKPEB)** - Reported a 40% growth in its order book to ₹1,376.4 crore, with shares trading around ₹239–₹240.
* **EBGNG (EBGNG)** - Stock hit a fresh 52-week high of Rs 704.55 on September 10, 2026.
* **QPOWER (QPOWER)** - Stock closed down 3.63% at ₹1,458 on September 10, 2026, and hosted an investor plant visit on September 11 showcasing Winwin Speciality Insulators Limited.
* **RATEGAIN (RATEGAIN)** - Named a "Favoured Connectivity Partner" by Trip.com Group for the third consecutive year and reported early September booking volume up 36% and booking value up 82% over August.
* **SAREGAMA (SAREGAMA)** - Filed a contempt plea in Delhi High Court against composer Ilaiyaraaja over alleged copyright injunction breaches, seeking his detention and asset freeze.
* **SHILPAMED (SHILPAMED)** - Initiated Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process against wholly owned subsidiary FTF Pharma Private Limited following an NCLT order.
* **SHREEREF (SHREEREF)** - Stock declined 3.93% in the last 24 hours to 405.00 on September 11, 2026.
* **TANFACIND (TANFACIND)** - MarketsMojo assigned a "Hold" rating on September 10, 2026.
* **TDPOWERSYS (TDPOWERSYS)** - Shareholders approved a ₹75 crore preferential equity issuance and a Qualified Institutions Placement during an EGM.
* **VENUSPIPES (VENUSPIPES)** - Board will meet on September 16 to consider fundraising via preferential issue or private placement, with the trading window closed effective September 10.

us_invested.summary:
* **HIMS (HIMS)** - Faces multiple securities class action lawsuits over alleged violations, while Bienville Capital disclosed a new $27.24 million position.
* **JNJ (JNJ)** - Received CE Marking for ACUVUE OASYS MAX Reusable Contact Lenses and scheduled presentations for the Morgan Stanley Healthcare Conference and Psych Congress.
* **KRYS (KRYS)** - Highlighted its transition to a multi-product genetic medicines platform amid slowing U.S. VYJUVEK sales growth at a Cantor conference, while institutional investors acquired new positions.
* **META (META)** - Upgraded by JPMorgan on Muse AI agent optimism, despite receiving a San Francisco cease-and-desist notice regarding AI-generated child exploitation material in ads.
* **ORCL (ORCL)** - Shares fell ~5.4% despite beating Q1 FY27 results with $19.3B in revenue (+30%) and raising full-year EPS guidance, as Guggenheim maintained its $400 price target.
* **RKLB (RKLB)** - Analysts noted the stock may be undervalued despite recent price weakness.
* **TWST (TWST)** - First Light Asset Management cut its stake by 17.2%, while company leadership scheduled a fireside chat at the Baird 2026 Global Healthcare Conference.
* **Zscaler, Inc. (ZS)** - Maintained a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with a $216.65 target price, with DCF valuation models indicating the stock is undervalued.
* **ASX (ASX)** - Zacks highlighted LEAP services momentum as 2026 revenues track ahead of the $3.5 billion target and $2 billion was added to 2026 CapEx plans.
* **AMKR (AMKR)** - Shares fell 3.5% to $49.53 on September 10, 2026, crossing the significant stock movement threshold.
* **AVGO (AVGO)** - Declined on soft revenue guidance despite record AI chip growth, while Piper Sandler initiated coverage at "Buy" ($460 target) and Future Fund increased its stake.
* **GE Vernova (GEV)** - IPG Investment Advisors increased its stake by 37.8%, as reported on September 10, 2026.
* **ARM (ARM)** - Initiated with an "Overweight" rating and $320 target at Piper Sandler, while CEO Rene A. Haas was granted 425,000 RSUs tied to market cap milestones.
* **CLS (CLS)** - Tidal Investments increased its stake by 198.2% and Junto Capital established a new $43.46 million position.
* **TransDigm Group (TDG)** - Hit a new 52-week low on September 10, 2026, while Winton Group raised its stake by 28.1% in Q2.
